rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X
positions.catalyst: Risk-on tape driven by weak July jobs (-23k NFP, soft wages) → active rate-cut repricing; 10y yield slipped to 4.60%, 1y inflation expectations to 3.6%; S&P futures +0.6% pre-market. Semis are THE 2026 leadership group (AMAT ~+110% YTD, COHR ~+105%) and are leading the pre-market bid: SOXL +1.68% pre-open vs TQQQ +0.55% / SPXL +0.27%. Next macro event is July CPI Wed Aug 12 (Cleveland Fed nowcast ~3.45%) — outside this 24h window since book rotates tomorrow AM.
positions.driver: LONG 3x semiconductors, 100% capital. On a soft-jobs / falling-yield risk-on Monday the most asymmetric next-24h expression is to ride the leadership group with the strongest relative strength — semis — via 3x SOXL. Chose SOXL over: TQQQ (3x Nasdaq, broader but lagging pre-market +0.55%, less beta to today's flow); SPXL (3x S&P, only +0.27%, too broad/slow for a moonshot); BITX (2x BTC, no fresh catalyst, BTC flat ~$65k). 3x leverage matched to the confluence of active rate-cut repricing + clearest sector momentum + confirming pre-market relative strength. Entry 142.61 = Robinhood real-time pre-market last (bid 142.50 / ask 142.77); dashboard proxy still showed the stale Aug-7 prior close ($140.25) pre-open, so used Robinhood live per canonical fallback. +1.68% pre-open is well under the 8-10% chase cap. Stop 128.35 (-10%, 3x band).
positions.risks: 3x semis is the highest-beta expression on the board: an intraday risk-off reversal (hawkish Fed-speak, a geopolitical/tariff headline, or profit-taking in extended chip names) is amplified ~3x and decay/path-dependence hurt on a choppy day. Semi-specific earnings cluster later this week (AMAT etc.) can inject sector volatility even before those prints. Mitigants: -10% hard stop caps the loss; ~24h hold via daily rotation exits before Wed CPI event risk; entered on confirmed pre-market relative strength, not a chase.
